data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 34.662m. During 2016 the Syndicate recorded a prior-year release of GBP 2.6m (negative movement), predominantly arising from the nuclear liability exposures, representing approximately a 7.5% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding. The movement is described in the notes as a release of technical reserves in respect of prior periods and is attributed to favourable claims development in the nuclear liability class.

The prior-year movement is stated as a release of GBP 2.6m in the notes (assumed gross). The claims development table is present but detailed cell extraction was not fully robust from the images; named events are those explicitly mentioned in the narrative and Underwriting performance section.
